subject: Timo Maas — First Day

symbols.L: FIRST_LIGHT / первый доступный свет или возможность начать
symbols.M: MOVEMENT / действие, переводящее возможность в переход
symbols.R: REBIRTH / перерождение или реальный новый старт
symbols.P(L): PROTECT_FIRST_LIGHT / не дать первому свету погаснуть до перехода

formalization.janus_formula: N --L--> POSSIBILITY; P(L) AND W AND M => R
formalization.state_transition: IF FIRST_LIGHT_EXISTS AND FIRST_LIGHT_IS_PROTECTED AND WILL_IS_PRESENT AND MOVEMENT_OCCURS THEN STATE_(t+1)=REBIRTH; ELSE STATE_(t+1) MAY_RETURN_TO_INNER_NIGHT
formalization.compressed: INNER_NIGHT -> FIRST_LIGHT -> PROTECT -> WILL -> MOVE -> REBIRTH

difference_from_reset.reason: A true First Day follows a prior night and therefore carries history. The new state is not identical to the old origin.
difference_from_reset.spiral_extension: R_(n+1) = ORIGIN_n + MEMORY + FIRST_LIGHT + WILL + MOVEMENT

operational_reading.input: A system/person has passed through an inner-night or shutdown state.
operational_reading.gate: A small viable first-light opportunity appears.
operational_reading.failure_mode: Opportunity is not protected, or will never becomes movement.
operational_reading.success_condition: The opportunity is protected long enough for will to become action.
operational_reading.output: A genuinely advanced state rather than cosmetic restart.

canonical_seal: FIRST DAY IS THE MOMENT A SURVIVING LIGHT BECOMES MOVEMENT. PROTECT THE LIGHT; LET WILL MOVE; DO NOT CALL A RESET A REBIRTH.
